value.signature: fn install_from_origin (origin : EntryOrigin , debug : bool , default_level : tracing :: Level , arguments : Value ,) -> Result < OriginInstallation , BootstrapError >

exception.justification: Justified: This entry-origin adapter installs the observer before a command span exists and transfers its duration to the explicit command root.

review.item_premise: This public origin installer delegates exactly once to the shared seam with the unchanged bootstrap body; its thin delegation remains source-read and body-pinned.
